description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four different methods—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, SemEval, and an unnamed method—across varying numbers of samples generated, measured by the Micro F1 score percentage. The x-axis represents the number of samples generated, with values at K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis measures the Micro F1 score percentage, ranging from approximately 25% to 52%. The TACRED line, marked with a blue line and circle markers, starts at around 23% at K=8, increases to about 30% at K=16, peaks at approximately 32% at K=32, and slightly decreases to around 30% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit line, indicated by an orange line with triangle markers, begins at roughly 24% at K=8, rises to about 30% at K=16, reaches a peak of around 32% at K=32, and then drops to approximately 29% at K=64. The SemEval line, shown with a green line and diamond markers, starts at about 40% at K=8, increases to around 45% at K=16, reaches its highest point at approximately 50% at K=32, and then slightly decreases to about 48% at K=64. The unnamed method, represented by a red line with star markers, begins at around 42% at K=8, climbs to about 45% at K=16, peaks at approximately 50% at K=32, and then slightly increases to around 51% at K=64.
